changes_vs_E1: Only run identity, seed and output directory; all model, training and verifier settings unchanged.

restart_evaluation.operational_policy: Return first candidate passing final_joint_pass, otherwise exhaust at3; report every attempted run.
restart_evaluation.decision: Retain as a useful T2 pilot only if complete data show k3 joint success count > k1 joint success count and at least one group is rescued; otherwise terminate this method. No significance claim, no extra seeds.

publication_note: Execution paths are portable. Numeric settings and seed schedules are unchanged. protocol_module_sha256 records original research code provenance; publication-only path/docstring changes are described in MultiStage/two_stage/README.md.
